item.title: Detecting Prompt Injection: The Playbook Your SIEM Doesn't Have Yet
item.author: chima.ukachukwu.sec@gmail.com (Chima Anthony Ukachukwu)
item.description: Prompt injection is succeeding in production right now, and most SOCs can't see it. Why traditional detection primitives partially-fail, three places where they can work, and what's still hard.

item.title: The Bridge — Why AI Security Needs SOC People, and SOC Needs AI Red Teamers
item.author: chima.ukachukwu.sec@gmail.com (Chima Anthony Ukachukwu)
item.description: Two communities that should be talking to each other are mostly not. Here's what each side is missing — and what bridging them looks like in practice.
